body:
Maps the `accel-kws` serial-MAC engine onto iCE40 UP5K and HX8K with the open flow: 15 geometries (H 8–128, 2/4/8-bit weights), 3 seeds each. All fit (≤1,138 of 5,280 UP5K LCs, ≤24 of 30 EBR); Fmax 15–22 MHz on UP5K. Stylised: random weights (Speech Commands unreachable), accuracy column borrowed from accel-kws, no board or power measurement. Wrapper RTL matches the integer reference on 45/45 random inputs. 5 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok. Includes README bullet, projects.json entry, PROJECTS.md note, run line.
